title: Contrastive belief-update measurement of reward-seeking on public Qwen2.5 models
description: The paper's contrastive-SDF measurement and controls port cleanly to Qwen2.5-7B/14B/32B, but the grader-following effects do not appear: style gaps are ~0 at every scale even where implanted beliefs demonstrably bind (32B: +0.06 log-odds with near-perfect belief recall), matching non-grader controls, and only the honesty axis shows a weak grader-ward likelihood shift (14B mean +10.2 nats, 8/9 seed pairs) above but overlapping control-corpus drift.
